card.name: Small words inside dosing instructions
card.fires_on: Short linking or setup words inside dosing and administration instructions, such as 'to' after 'physicians who wish', 'Weeks' in a dosing schedule, 'experienced' after 'Only physicians', or a digit or space before a number of hours or mL.

modes.label: Schedule words
modes.description: Weeks or a space before a number in a dosing time schedule.

modes.label: Who may give the drug
modes.description: Words after 'physicians' or 'healthcare professional' that set requirements for the person giving the drug.

modes.label: Inside amounts
modes.description: A digit or space within a volume or interval figure.
modes.example: Sterile Water for Injection (diluent) - At least 1<<4>> mL per vial of RUCON
